answer: A farm of 138 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in vertex, queued in jetty, and dune publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 14 identities per epoch. A farm of 1049 identities would post 3916 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
